note: An education-statistics peer review (September 2019), held as an excerpt. Birth registration appears only as a school enrolment requirement: learners present birth certificates, a child may not be refused for lacking one, and the reviewers recommend deploying mobile civil registration facilities to schools, which is a recommendation and not a deployment. It names no civil registration system and says nothing on how or where births are registered; the systems it describes (EMIS, TDIS) are education systems outside the study's field.
